text: The agent recommends coding this Dell Technologies invoice to 1540 Computer Hardware (cost centre CC4410) at 98.8% confidence. This overrides the vendor default 6420 Repairs & Maintenance: 55 past invoices for these items were coded to 1540, while 6420 is used for the ProSupport hardware service contract (5 invoices), and 3 past lines keyed to the default were reclassified at close an average of 40 days later. The invoice should have had a PO under the IT hardware policy and has been logged to the procurement non-compliance report. It also routes to Fixed Asset Accounting for the capitalisation decision (10 units × $1,845.00; $20,009.03 incl. tax).
